summary: Alder Fork School District is taking sealed bids to replace six packaged gas/electric rooftop units, from 7.5 to 15 tons, on the classroom wings of Sego Ridge Middle School in Alder Fork, Utah. The estimated construction cost is $210,000 to $260,000, with the work to be done June 1 to July 30, 2027. Bids are due Tuesday, March 23, 2027 at 1:00 p.m. at the District Office.

notes.text: The equipment schedule names an approved manufacturer, but the schedule was not part of the text that was read. To price another manufacturer, a written request must be made at least seven days before the bid date. With bids due March 23, 2027, that is read here as March 16, 2027; the text does not state the date itself or say who the request goes to.

Only firms that have carried out rooftop unit replacements at two or more schools or similar public buildings in the past four years may bid. The text does not say what counts as a similar public building.

The bid must include a signed Addenda Acknowledgment. No addenda were part of the text that was read, and the text does not say whether the form is still needed if none are issued. This reading treats it as required.

The text asks for sealed bids and gives the District Office, 300 Main Street, with the due time, but does not say outright how bids are to be delivered. This reading takes it that bids are handed in at the District Office. The last day for questions is March 15, 2027, with no time of day and no word on who to send them to.

Bonds and the certificate of insurance are due before the contract is signed, with no number of days given. All workers must complete the District's background check; the text does not say when. The text also does not say how the winner will be chosen.
